item.title: Speaker directs scheduling of Anti-Gay Bill and Constitution Amendment Bill in Parliament

item.description: By Love Wilhelmina Abanonave President John Dramani Mahama has acknowledged the crucial role traditional leaders play in Ghana’s governance, particularly in conflict resolution, noting that chiefs wield significant influence over their people and are key to maintaining peace, which he described as a prerequisite for development.
